name: chimera-lab
description: Three database agents that audit slow SQL, review indexes nightly and hunt lock contention, proposing fixes without running them.
author: GenUI Studio
highlights: Reads EXPLAIN plans and flags sequential scans on large tables
Detects N+1 query loops in application code and proposes batched rewrites
Designs composite indexes (equality, sort, range) with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
Nightly review of unused and redundant indexes
Finds blocking chains, long transactions and lock waits
Proposes changes only; never runs DDL or cancels backends

crons.name: chimera-bottleneck-audit
crons.message: Run a CHIMERA bottleneck audit with the bio-query-optimizer skill. Use the repository in $CHIMERA_PROJECT_DIR and, if set, the read-only database URL in $CHIMERA_DATABASE_URL. Review git commits from the last six hours for new queries and loops that issue queries, run EXPLAIN (no ANALYZE) on the slowest statements, and report sequential scans, N+1 patterns and missing composite indexes with proposed SQL. Do not run DDL or modify files.

crons.name: chimera-nightly-index-review
crons.message: Run the nightly CHIMERA index review against the read-only database in $CHIMERA_DATABASE_URL: propose missing composite indexes for the slowest statements and list unused or redundant indexes. Do not run DDL.

crons.name: chimera-lock-watch
crons.message: Check the read-only database in $CHIMERA_DATABASE_URL for blocking chains, long or idle-in-transaction sessions and ungranted locks. Report only when something is blocked or a transaction is older than five minutes. Do not cancel or terminate backends.

setup.onInstall: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
setup.onUpdate: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
